sections.basis: IRPEF taxable income, per year (bands as published by MEF; see the special rules)
sections.note: A single rate on all taxable income.

rows.label: Special rules (disposizioni particolari)
rows.value: Income up to €50,000: €200 credit per dependent minor child (child's income up to €4,000), plus €100 per child with a disability. No refund.
